The __________ tradition features finely made, leaf-shaped stone blades. The __________

The influence of the Tiwanaku was eclipsed by the _________ culture, to the north and
west.
questions.answer_explanation: The Toltec culture, known for its significant political and military influence in Mesoamerica, rose to prominence around the 10th century, overshadowing the earlier achievements of the Tiwanaku civilization, which was located in the Andean region to the south.

questions.stem_text:
